content.body:
I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

Emma, driving revenue across 38 markets at Revolut means your team in London is constantly pressured to move fast on product decisions — and in a market doubling down on cost consolidation, slow feedback loops become a direct tax on roadmap precision.

Tightening the loop between real-time customer signals and roadmap prioritisation lets Revolut's product teams ship with confidence rather than assumption, compressing the time between feature release and measurable adoption.

For a pioneering fintech, we migrated 840+ scripts across 10+ business units from Databricks to Amazon EMR, achieving roughly 50% platform cost reduction while maintaining scalability and performance.

Would a focused 20-minute call next week be useful to walk through how we've done this for similar-scale fintechs?

content.body:
Hi Emma Clarke,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

Emma, coordinating revenue decisions across 38 markets from London means your team is under constant pressure to ship the right product bets fast — and in a cost-optimization cycle, slow feedback loops between what 50M+ customers actually do and what ends up on the roadmap become a direct tax on revenue precision at $100B+ in annual transaction volume.

We help fintech teams like yours tighten that loop — turning real-time customer signals into faster, evidence-backed roadmap calls so fewer resources get spent on features that don't move the needle.

For one pioneering fintech, we migrated 840+ scripts across 10+ business units to Amazon EMR, achieving ~50% platform cost reduction while maintaining scalability and performance — exactly the kind of infrastructure efficiency that compounds when you're operating at Revolut's scale.

Would a focused 20-minute call next week be useful to walk through how this maps to Revolut's current setup?

With regards,
Ganit team
